name: tinycell
description: Host-blind fixed-timestep cell engine. One App owns the rules and the grid; the host only paints, feeds keys, and stores bytes.
author: Farzad Yousefzadeh <farskid@gmail.com> (https://farzadyz.me)

scripts.test: node --experimental-transform-types --test --test-concurrency=1 src/engine.test.ts src/ANSIPainter.test.ts src/TTY.test.ts src/CanvasPainter.test.ts src/WebEvent.test.ts src/WebSwipe.test.ts games/space-invaders/SpaceInvaders.test.ts games/flappy/Flappy.test.ts games/fx.test.ts games/2048/Game2048.test.ts
